name: Gregory J. Hollon
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Gregory J. Hollon is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2005, 2010 - 2026. He works at McNaul Ebel PLLC, located in Seattle, Washington, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation and Professional Liability: Defense to the surrounding community.
Gregory Hollon completed legal studies at Harvard Law School and graduated with the class of 1996. Gregory Hollon passed the bar in 1996.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
